DAILY_RRULE = "DTSTART:20230118T000000\nRRULE:FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1"

BERLIN = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo("Europe/Berlin")


def _event_schedule(event, user, next_run, rrule=DAILY_RRULE):
    return ScheduledEventExport.objects.create(
        event=event, owner=user, export_identifier='itemdata', export_form_data={'_format': 'default'},

    )


def _organizer_schedule(organizer, user, next_run, rrule=DAILY_RRULE):
    return ScheduledOrganizerExport.objects.create(
        organizer=organizer, owner=user, export_identifier='eventdata', export_form_data={},
        locale='en', mail_subject='Export', mail_template='Mail body', schedule_rrule=rrule,
        schedule_rrule_time=time(6, 30), schedule_next_run=next_run, timezone='Europe/Berlin',
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_dispatches_due_event_export(event, user):
    with freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00+01:00"):
        s = _event_schedule(event, user, next_run=datetime(2023, 1, 19, 6, 30, tzinfo=BERLIN))

        with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

        apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'event': event.pk, 'schedule': s.pk})
        s.refresh_from_db()
        assert s.schedule_next_run == datetime(2023, 1, 20, 6, 30, tzinfo=BERLIN)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_dispatches_due_organizer_export(event, user):

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_skips_schedules_not_yet_due(event, user):
    with freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00+01:00"):
        future = datetime(2023, 1, 20, 6, 30, tzinfo=BERLIN)
        _event_schedule(event, user, next_run=future)
        _organizer_schedule(event.organizer, user, next_run=future)
        _event_schedule(event, user, next_run=None)

        with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as event_apply_async, \
                mock.patch.object(scheduled_organizer_export, 'apply_async') as organizer_apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

        event_apply_async.assert_not_called()
        organizer_apply_async.assert_not_called()


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_runs_last_occurrence_once(event, user):
    with freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00+01:00"):
        s = _event_schedule(
            event, user, next_run=datetime(2023, 1, 18, 6, 30, tzinfo=BERLIN), rrule=SINGLE_RUN_RRULE
        )

        with mock.patch.object(scheduled_event_export, 'apply_async') as apply_async:
            run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)
            run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

        apply_async.assert_called_once_with(kwargs={'event': event.pk, 'schedule': s.pk})
        s.refresh_from_db()
        assert s.schedule_next_run is None


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_run_scheduled_exports_sends_export_to_owner(event, user):
    with freeze_time("2023-01-19 12:00:00+01:00"):
        _event_schedule(event, user, next_run=datetime(2023, 1, 19, 6, 30, tzinfo=BERLIN))

        djmail.outbox = []
        run_scheduled_exports(sender=None)

    assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
    assert djmail.outbox[0].to == [user.email]
    assert djmail.outbox[0].subject == 'Export'
    assert len(djmail.outbox[0].attachments) == 1
